capabilities: Insert links to missing linked mentions at the cursor
Import notes matching a selected tag into the current note
Import notes matching a selected alias into the current note
Link to the closest heading as anchor links
extras: Free, but the author solicits Ko-fi donations; bug reports go through the GitHub issues tab; there is a timing caveat where newly created links or tags may not be immediately visible to the plugin.
problem: MOCs end up missing notes because users forget to add reciprocal links, and tagged notes lack a running index list.
summary: MOC maintenance plugin that inserts links to a note's missing linked mentions, tagged notes, or alias matches at the cursor.
